title: One deep-dive site in QB5_J#q2 still asserted automatic EIAPP invalidation after Pass 1 corrected the rule above it
candidate_claim: Founder/GPT independent high-risk review. Pass 1 (CORR-GPT-PASS1-20260904) corrected the absolute proposition 'going outside Technical File settings invalidates the EIAPP certificate' to the proper conditional / verification wording. Tranche 1 found one surviving candidate-facing site in the same card, equivalent to 'outside it the EIAPP is invalidated'.
candidate_verdict: UPHELD. The site is the Deep-Dive Trap Questions block: 'Q: Can you advance the timing to recover performance? A: Only within the NOx Technical File - outside it the EIAPP is invalidated.' It is the same rejected proposition, in the same card, in the answer to a question a candidate will actually be asked. This is known_traps entry 66 firing again in the card that produced it: correcting a rule does not correct the illustration that follows it. THE REST OF THE ANSWER WAS NOT REOPENED.

authority.governing_record: CORR-GPT-PASS1-20260904, whose authority block carries the NOx Technical Code 2008 operative text at 2.4.1, 2.4.3.1, 2.4.4, 6.2.1.1, 6.2.1.2 and 6.2.1.4 and the reasoning why the absolute form is impossible. NOTHING NEW IS ESTABLISHED HERE. This record propagates an already-governed proposition to a site the earlier scope pass missed, and the corrected text is the Pass-1 wording.
authority.corrected_proposition: 'Only within the full range of adjustments the NOx Technical File identifies as allowable. Working outside the approved configuration has to go down the applicable approved route - amendment of the technical file, and verification at survey by the engine parameter check method - and an unapproved departure can leave the engine no longer compliant with its certified NOx configuration.' Word-for-word the modality Pass 1 established in the body Trap point and the REG-BOX.
